record.title: South Ossetia de facto authorities close Odzisi and Sinaguri passages

record.crossings: Odzisi; Sinaguri; later reopening source uses Karzmani
record.exceptions: Medical and other exceptional permissions; special-pass holiday openings included June 13–17, 2022, with an earlier Easter window also reported.

record.enforcement: EUMM direct monitoring establishes closure and later limited monthly operation.
